title: Majority on a three-coordinate input
statement: For every sign $s\in\{-1,1\}$ and every coordinate $j\in\{1,2,3\}$, form a three-coordinate input whose $j$th entry is $-s$ and whose other two entries are $s$. The majority function on this input equals $s$.
